visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable/source-terrain frames. Individual Brno Petrov cathedral has twin square stone towers at the nave/choir junction, tall open pointed belfries, small open crowns and very slender green metal needle spires. The broad higher western nave has a gray-green metal roof and four small dormers per side; the lower polygonal eastern choir has a smaller ridge fleche. Warm rubble masonry, pale stone trim, recessed pointed glazing, stepped buttresses/pinnacles, low northern chapels and southern vestry retain the exterior hierarchy. Western gabled facade has a broad pointed upper window, narrower flanking windows, modeled arch surrounds and an open outer porch with a closed wood entry behind it. Corrected the porch back face that occluded the recessed entry and cut both side arch apertures fully through the inner wall skin; deeper cavity probes pass. Removed the extra horizontal foundation cap from the entry area. Exact carved figures, reliefs/inscriptions, stained-glass art and fine latticework omitted.
